quest.title: Chasing Shadows
quest.description: The person Diluc called in turned out to be Jean from the Knights of Favonius. After some discussions, it is discovered that it was the Fatui who stole the Holy Lyre der Himmel. You must retrieve it to rescue Dvalin.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x175, Mora x4225, Character EXP x2200, Fine Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Player returned to the world. Tavern cleared.

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Guard
dialogues.text: No, NO! Don't eat me! Ah? You're... You're human?

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Guard
dialogues.text: The entire floor's defenses... have been broken. I thought it was the Abyss Order attacking...

choices.text: We have come for the Holy Lyre der Himmel.

response.speaker: Fatui Guard
response.text: H—How did you guys know the lyre's here?

response.speaker: Fatui Guard
response.text: The place it's being kept is locked up tight. If you're after the key, keep going further into the ruins, but d—don't come after me!

response.speaker: Fatui Guard
response.text: I don't know which one of the guards has it, but I'm sure you can find the guards and find out for yourselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This guy looks like he's about to wet himself...

response.speaker: Fatui Guard
response.text: Y—You just worry about yourselves!

response.speaker: Fatui Guard
response.text: One of the Harbingers is already in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Fatui Guard
response.text: Signora. When she gets her hands on you she's going to string you up and torture you. When that time comes, don't you dare say a word about me.

choices.text: We have come for your life.

response.speaker: Fatui Guard
response.text: Ahh, Ah, Ah!

response.speaker: Fatui Guard
response.text: No, don't! I have valuable information! I'll tell you!

response.speaker: Fatui Guard
response.text: We hid the Holy Lyre in the depths of these ruins.
